items.content:
The people who unlock every ending are not thorough. They are refusing to
have chosen.

A decision you can undo is not a decision, it is a preview. And if you
see all four endings then the game has no ending — it has a catalogue,
and you were a tourist in something that was asking you to commit.

I say this as someone with eleven saves.

summary: Unlocking every ending is refusing to commit to one
title: On completionism as a way of avoiding the decision
